name: Jiangsu Gian Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu Gian Technology Co., Ltd. is a global manufacturer and supplier specializing in metal injection molding (MIM) components. The company produces a wide array of precision-engineered metal parts—encompassing structural, functional, and cosmetic elements—that cater to diverse applications in industries such as electronics, automotive, medical devices, and tooling. Beyond its core MIM production, Jiangsu Gian engages in research and development, particularly focusing on advancements in vacuum ion plating film technology. It also provides comprehensive manufacturing and finishing services, including vacuum coating, precise parts fabrication, laser processing, welding, sandblasting, wire drawing, anti-fingerprint treatment, and surface grinding, as well as PVD. The company's commercial offerings extend to the sale of mechanical equipment, electronic goods, and various metal and plastic products. Additionally, it delivers specialized integrated solutions, such as precision transmission systems and thermal management solutions, for high-demand sectors like consumer electronics, 5G communication base stations, servers, projectors, and AR/VR devices. Customized parts and mold fabrication are also part of its service portfolio. Founded in 2004, the company initially operated as Changzhou Gian Technology Co., Ltd., before officially changing its name to Jiangsu Gian Technology Co., Ltd. in 2015. Its headquarters are located in Changzhou, China.
